verdict.rationale: Shared team inboxes with presence, conversation assignment, and internal notes are a fair question for a customer-communications platform like Twilio, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only developer building blocks: messaging and voice APIs, real-time Sync, and phone number management. None of these is a documented shared-number team collaboration capability with presence, assignment, or internal threads.

support.subject: As a support leader, several teammates share one number with presence, conversation assignment, and internal threads
